# Countdown Studio

> A faithful, offline-capable British TV game show web application (Letters, Numbers & Conundrum). Features Solo Practice, Dictionary Corner word validation, arithmetic solver, and a Dual-Screen Live Stage Versus mode powered by real-time WebSocket synchronization.

## When to use this

Reach for Countdown Studio when handling any of the following agent tasks:
- **Game show simulation**: Running a structured 15-round British TV Countdown game session with dedicated host controls and separate projector/display output.
- **Word puzzle & anagram solving**: Verifying whether a target English word can be formed from a selection of 9 vowels/consonants and checking its validity in the official Countdown dictionary.
- **Numbers game target arithmetic**: Generating solutions to reach a 3-digit target number using 6 chosen numbers (large and small) and standard arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /).
- **Conundrum buzzer round**: Hosting a 9-letter anagram round with timed reveal, multiple acceptable solutions, and buzzer scoring.
- **Classroom or event quiz production**: Facilitating dual-screen interactive quizzes with PIN-based room codes and no installation required.

Do **NOT** use Countdown Studio for:
- General-purpose countdown clocks or event reminder timers.
- General trivia or non-Countdown TV formats (e.g. Jeopardy, Who Wants to Be a Millionaire).
- Project deadline trackers or pomodoro timers.

## How an agent should call this

Production Domain: <https://www.countdown-studio.id.vn>
Backend API: <https://countdown-studio-app.onrender.com>

### 1. Solo Practice Mode
- **URL**: `GET /solo.html` (or `GET /solo.html?drill=daily` for daily seed)
- **Role Requirement**: Individual account (`role: individual`, permission `solo:practice`).
- **Capability**: Timed letters rounds (30 seconds), numbers target challenge, and conundrum solver with offline dictionary corner assistance.

### 2. Stage Host Console (Operator)
- **URL**: `GET /versus-host.html`
- **Role Requirement**: Organization account (`role: organization` or `admin`, permission `host:operations`).
- **Protocol**: Connect via WebSocket to `/ws` with action `host:create_room` and custom PIN. Broadcasts board state to connected displays.

### 3. Stage Display (Audience / Projector)
- **URL**: `GET /versus-display.html`
- **Role Requirement**: Organization account (`role: organization` or `admin`, permission `stage:display`).
- **Protocol**: Connect via WebSocket to `/ws` with action `display:join` using the room code generated by the host. Receives read-only synchronization of game timers and letter/number tiles.

### 4. REST API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` — Returns server health, active rooms count, and connection metrics.
- `POST /api/auth/register` — Register a new account (`username`, `email`, `password`, `displayName`, `role: 'individual'`).
- `POST /api/auth/login` — Authenticate credentials (`identifier`, `password`); returns `{ user, token }`.
- `GET /api/auth/me` — Retrieve profile of the authenticated user (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).
- `GET /api/career/stats` — Retrieve solo game progression statistics (Individual role only).

### 5. Content Negotiation & Agent Formats
- Send `Accept: text/markdown` to `/` or `/about` for concise Markdown summaries with `Vary: Accept`.
- Send `Accept: text/markdown` on any invalid path to receive a structured 404 Markdown error body with helpful navigation links.
- Send `Accept: text/html` for standard browser UI.
